turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
I'm here about Owen's essay. Who decided on the zero?
Tell me what you had for breakfast, then spell it backwards.
No. Who decided on the zero, and when?
Then tell me something only a real mother would know about her son.
My son isn't a test you get to run. You called this meeting, so start with what you have.
